Use a Unix host with make, Git and uv installed, and an activated Python 3.11 virtual environment as shown in the documented manual setup example. Preserve clean and setup prerequisites: setup updates the notebook submodule and installs all listed PyTorch/Fabric test requirements plus editable package/pre-commit setup; allow the declared source/package downloads. The Makefile itself retains PACKAGE_NAME=pytorch, SLURM_LOCALID=0 and SPHINX_MOCK_REQUIREMENTS=1.
Prepare an Ubuntu 24.04 checkout with autoconf, automake, bison, build-essential, libevent-dev, libncurses-dev, libutf8proc-dev and pkg-config as in the upstream regression workflow.
Before entering regress, build this checkout at the root using sh autogen.sh, then ./configure --enable-utf8proc --enable-asan, then make; regression scripts use the resulting ../tmux binary.
Prepare a complete checkout with plugins/python-build, plugins/pyenv-binary and plugins/pyenv-link present; Makefile test depends on all four host suites.
Provide make, Bash 3.2 or newer, Git and standard Unix tools; the Makefile fetches Bats v1.10.0 from GitHub and prepares the bats symlink.
On macOS install coreutils and fish, as required by .github/workflows/pyenv_tests.yml.
Run the unfiltered host suite; BATS_FILE_FILTER and BATS_TEST_FILTER narrow it as documented in test/README.md.
